Flowing Rainbow

Kit summary

Knockback Water-ShootingBasic
Deals 3 stages of 120% ATK DMG each to a single enemy and steals 6% Turn Meter from the target, or 10% when landing a Crit.
Fresh SummerActive
Increases all allies' ATK by 40% for 2 turns. Afterward, deals 3 stages of ATK DMG (85% at least, up to 170%) each to all enemies. The more layers of [Flowing Rainbow] the targets have, the more DMG dealt.
Jolly Water FightPassiveExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.2 · Lv.3
At the beginning of each wave, Lydia always acts first. She will reset the CD of all her skills and gain corresponding effect based on the first skill she casts: If she casts Knockback Water-shooting or Fresh Summer first, all allies will gain [Rapid Flow], which will last until the wave transition; If she casts Joyful Party first, all allies will gain [Water Curtain], which will last until the wave transition; After an ally with [Rapid Flow] casts active skill for 8 times in total, Lydia will cast Bullet Chase for once; After an ally with [Water Curtain] takes Basic Attack DMG or Skill DMG for 12 times in total, Lydia will cast Bullet Counterattack for once; Bullet Chase/Bullet Counterattack: Deals 140% ATK DMG to all enemies and inflicts 1 layer of [Flowing Rainbow]. Both [Rapid Flow] and [Water Curtain] are considered as [Consolidation].
Water Gun Revelry Lv.1Allies with [Rapid Flow] will gain 10% Turn Meter after launching basic attacks proactively. After allies with [Water Curtain] take Basic Attack DMG or Skill DMG, steals 1 layer of a random buff from the target. If the target doesn't have any buffs, inflicts 1 layer of [Flowing Rainbow] on the target.
Water Gun Revelry Lv.2When Lydia grants an ally [Rapid Flow], additionally increases the target's Basic Attack DMG and Skill DMG dealt by 30%. Also, every time she casts Bullet Chase, reduces the CD of all allies' skills by 1 turn; every time she grants an ally [Water Curtain], additionally reduces the target's Basic Attack DMG and Skill DMG taken by 30%. In addition, every time she casts Bullet Counterattack, there is a 100% chance to increase the CD of all enemies' skills by 1 turn (caps at the Max CD).
Water Gun Revelry Lv.3At the beginning of each wave, inflicts 1 layer of [Flowing Rainbow] on all enemies. There is a 50% chance to inflict [Imprison] for 1 turn when Bullet Chase or Bullet Counterattack deals DMG. Also, Lydia gains 1 layer (up to 10 layers) of [Extra Bullets] after casting Bullet Chase or Bullet Counterattack each time. [Extra Bullets]: Increases self Piercing Rate by 8% and Crit DMG by 15%. This effect cannot be removed when the owner dies or at the wave transition.
Joyful PartyActive
Increases all allies' Tenacity by 60% for 2 turns and deals 5 stages of 50% ATK DMG each to all enemies. Afterward, inflicts 1 layer of [Flowing Rainbow] on all enemies, with a 90% chance to inflict [Imprison] on enemies with 2 or more layers of [Flowing Rainbow] for 1 turn. [Flowing Rainbow]: Each layer reduces Effect Hit and Effect RES by 4%, up to 10 layers.

Traveler’s Diary
The Traveler's Diary
Main statATK Rate

At the beginning of the owner's turn, grants one of the Travelogue Pages randomly to all allies:

1. Increases all allies' ATK by 9% of the owner's initial ATK.

2. Increases all allies' Crit DMG by 27%.

3. Increases all allies' Skill DMG by 9%.

Only 1 layer of Travelogue Page can be owned at the same time and all allies share the same effect. The effects mentioned above will be removed once the owner dies.

Uplifting Drums
Uplifting Drums
Main statEffect Hit

Increases all allies' ATK by 7% when a battle starts.

If an ally is inflicted with Block Removal, the ally will gain 1 layer of Energizing Notes at the end of the following 3 turns, up to 1 layer can be gained at the end of each turn. Each layer of Energizing Notes increases ATK by 1.4%, up to 40 layers. This effect will not be removed when the owner dies or at the wave transition.

Additionally, when an ally is inflicted with Block Removal in their first 3 turns each wave, there is a 100% chance to gain 1 extra layer. This chance is not affected by Effect Hit or Effect RES.

If the same Echo is equipped by multiple allies at the same time in a battle, only one of them will take effect.
